author: Cory

fields.homeowner_question: The report says the leak was repaired. Was the repair seen during the visit, and was the area rechecked afterward?
fields.principle: When a report says a source was repaired, note whether the repair was seen or only reported, and whether the area was rechecked afterward. Never ask who made the repair or when.

note: Aligned with the cause-and-repair rule: never ask who repaired it or when; only whether the repair was seen and whether the area was rechecked.
